snippet.title: WIZORDUM | Launch Trailer | Out Now!
snippet.description:
🧙‍♂️ Play now! ► http://WIZORDUM.com | 15% OFF for a limited time!
Battle the forces of Chaos and bring peace back to Terrabruma in this retro-inspired fantasy FPS! Face deadly enemies, master three new elemental weapons, and conquer six sprawling new levels filled with lava, ice, and ancient magic.

Wield the mighty Faewood Crossbow, poison your foes with explosive vials, and unleash devastating elemental fury with the Staff of Chaos. And for those bold enough... Harness the raw destructive power of the Grimoire, the ultimate weapon forged from the shadows of a fallen necromancer.

New in Wizordum 1.0:
 • Six massive new levels, packed with secrets and danger
 • New elemental weapons: Faewood Crossbow, Poison Vials, and Staff of Chaos
 • The Grimoire: the ultimate force of chaotic magic
 • Two brand-new biomes: Inferno Citadel and Frozen Caverns
 • Enhanced quality-of-life improvements across all previous episodes

Plus, dive into the intuitive Level Editor. No modding experience needed! Build your own adventures or jump right into tons of community-created levels already live and ready for battle. Endless boomer shooter magic awaits!

🎵 The Wizordum Original Soundtrack is also coming soon to all major music platforms.

Grab your wand, ready your spells, and face the final battle.
Wizordum 1.0 — Available Now on Steam!
15% OFF for a limited time!
